div.head: Abt 71
div.ab: Æt þam oðrum taum gehwilcum healf gelde, ealswa æt þam fingrum ys cwiden.
Æt þam oðrum taum gehwilcum healf gelde, ealswa æt þam fingrum ys cwiden.
Æt þam oðrum taum gehwilcum, healfe gelde ealswa æt þam fingrum ys cwiden.
Bei den anderen Zehen allen zahle er [ebenfalls] je halb so [viel], wie bei den Fingern [oben] verkündet worden ist.
For all the other toes let him pay [likewise] half as [much] each as has been declared [above] for the fingers.
For each of the other toes, [a sum] equal to half that laid down for the corresponding fingers shall be paid.
For each of the other toes let him pay half the amount already discussed for the fingers.

note.seg: S. o. 70². Ebenso bei anderen Germanen; Wilda 770
See above 70². The same among other Germanic peoples; Wilda 770

healfgelde ‘mit Halbersatz’ wäre ein mögliches, aber nicht nachgewiesenes Kompositum. Healfswa ‘¹/₂ so viel’ bei Toller 940 n. II. Nicht etwa halbsoviel wie für die grosse Zehe kann gemeint sein laut des folgenden Zitats

healfgelde ‘with half-compensation’ would be a possible but unattested compound. Healfswa ‘¹/₂ as much’ in Toller 940 n. II. As the following citation shows, what is meant cannot be, say, half as much as for the big toe
